name: Brainstorm Session
description: Brainstorming and ideation session template for generating, evaluating, and prioritizing ideas.

sections.title: Context & Problem Statement
sections.instruction: Summarize the problem or challenge being addressed, including relevant background and constraints.

sections.title: Ideas Generated
sections.instruction: List all ideas proposed during the session, including brief descriptions where helpful.

sections.title: Evaluation & Prioritization
sections.instruction: List the ideas that were selected for further exploration, with reasoning for prioritization.

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.instruction: List all assigned tasks with their owners and due date. Always add reference transcript segment and timestamp in the table.
sections.item_format:
| **Owner** | Task | Due | Reference Transcript Segment | Segment Time stamp |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
